bioconda.name: bioconductor-linnorm
bioconda.summary: Linear model and normality based normalization and transformation method (Linnorm)

biotools.summary: Linnorm is an algorithm for normalizing and transforming RNA-seq, single cell RNA-seq, ChIP-seq count data or any large scale count data. It has been independently reviewed by Tian et al. on Nature Methods (https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-019-0425-8). Linnorm can work with raw count, CPM, RPKM, FPKM and TPM.
